sections.description:
THE TOLLS (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) ACT, 1901
THE TOLLS (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) ACT, 1901
ACT No. II of 1901
[22nd
February, 1901]
An Act to amend the law relating to the exemption from tolls of persons
and property belonging to the Army (Ins. by the
Repealing and Amending Act, 1927 (10 of 1927), s. 2 and Sch. I.)[or Air Force].
[WHEREAS (Subs. by the Indian Tolls (Army and Air Force) (Amdt.) Act, 1951 (38 of
1951), s. 2, for the original preamble as amended by Act 10 of 1927.)it
is necessary to provide for the exemption from the payment of certain duties or
tolls of certain officers, soldiers, airmen and other persons, and certain
animals, baggage and carriages belonging or attached to the Pakistan Army, or
the (The word "Royal" omitted by A. O., 1961,
Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)* Pakistan Air
Force ;]
[THE SCHEDULE.] Rep. by the Repealing and Amending Act, 1914 (X of
1914), s. 3 and Schedule 11.

Short title extent and commencement

THE TOLLS (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) ACT, 1901
THE TOLLS (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) ACT, 1901
ACT No. II of 1901
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, 1899, Pt. V, p. 175; for Report of the Select Committee, see
ibid., 1901, Pt. V, p. 7; for Proceedings in Council, see ibid. 1900, Pt. VI,
p. 236; ibid., 1901, Pt. VI, pp. 11 and 16.
The Act has been declared in force in Baluchistan by
Baluchistan Regulation No. II of 1913, s. 3.
It has also been extended to the Leased Areas of Baluchistan,
see the Leased Areas (Laws) Order, 1950 (G. G. O. 3 of 1950); and applied in
the Federated Areas of Baluchistan, see Gazette of India, 1937, Pt. 1, p. 1499.
It has been extended to the Baluchistan States Union by the
Baluchistan States Union (Federal Laws) (Extension) Order, 1953 (G. G. O. 4 of
1953), as amended.
It has also been extended to the Khairpur State, see G. G. O.
5 of 1953, as amended by G. G. O. 24 of 1953.
The Act has been and shall be deemed to have been brought
into force in Gwadur with effect from the 8th September, 1958, by the Gwadur
(Applica tion of Central Laws) Ordinance, 1960 (37 of 1960) s. 2.)
[22nd
February, 1901]
An Act to amend the law relating to the exemption from tolls of persons
and property belonging to the Army (Ins. by the
Repealing and Amending Act, 1927 (10 of 1927), s. 2 and Sch. I.)[or Air Force].
[WHEREAS (Subs. by the Indian Tolls (Army and Air Force) (Amdt.) Act, 1951 (38 of
1951), s. 2, for the original preamble as amended by Act 10 of 1927.)it
is necessary to provide for the exemption from the payment of certain duties or
tolls of certain officers, soldiers, airmen and other persons, and certain
animals, baggage and carriages belonging or attached to the Pakistan Army, or
the (The word "Royal" omitted by A. O., 1961,
Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)* Pakistan Air
Force ;]
It is hereby enacted as follows :‑
1. Short title extent and commencement-----‑(1) This Act may
be called the (The word "Indian" omitted by
Act 38 of 1951, s. 3.)* Tolls (Subs. by the
Indian Tolls (Army) Amendment Act, 1942 (14of 1942), s. 2, for
"Army".)[(Army and Air Force)] Act, 1901.
[(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.]( Subs. by the Indian Tolls (Army and Air
Force) (Amdt.) Act, 1951 (38 of 1951), s. 3, for sub‑section (2).)
(3) It shall come into force on
the first day of April, 1901.

State, when on duty or on the march ;]

sections.shortTitle: Tolls Army and Air Force Act 1901
sections.description:
Tolls on vessels transporting troops and baggage etc., of troops embarked or dis-embarked

THE TOLLS (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) ACT, 1901
THE TOLLS (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) ACT, 1901
ACT No. II of 1901
[22nd
February, 1901]
An Act to amend the law relating to the exemption from tolls of persons
and property belonging to the Army (Ins. by the
Repealing and Amending Act, 1927 (10 of 1927), s. 2 and Sch. I.)[or Air Force].
[WHEREAS (Subs. by the Indian Tolls (Army and Air Force) (Amdt.) Act, 1951 (38 of
1951), s. 2, for the original preamble as amended by Act 10 of 1927.)it
is necessary to provide for the exemption from the payment of certain duties or
tolls of certain officers, soldiers, airmen and other persons, and certain
animals, baggage and carriages belonging or attached to the Pakistan Army, or
the (The word "Royal" omitted by A. O., 1961,
Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)* Pakistan Air
Force ;]
4. Tolls on vessels transporting troops and baggage etc., of troops
embarked or dis-embarked---‑(1) No tolls shall be leviable by any
local authority in respect of‑----
(a) any vessel employed by (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "the Govt.".)[the
Central Government] solely for the transport of troops, or
(b) the horses, baggage or other
effects of any troops embarking or disembarking at any port, or
(c) carriages belonging to (Subs. by Act 38 of 1951, s. 6, for "His Majesty or
employed in His Majesty's".)[the Central Government or employed in]
military (Ins. by the Repealing and Amending Act, 1927
(10 of 1927), s. 2 and Sch. I.)[or air‑force] service embark ing
or disembarking at any port.
(2) In respect of all such vessels
or troops, their families, their horses, baggage and their effects, or any such
carriages as aforesaid, the local authority concerned shall, in addition to its
duties in the embarking and disembarking of the same, perform and supply all
such reasonable services and accommodation as may, from time to time, be
required by (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "the
Govt.".) [the Central Govern ment], and shall receive payment for
all such services and accom modation on such terms and for such periods as may,
from time to time, be determined by (Subs. by A. O.,
1937, for "the Govt.".)[the Central Government] in consulta tion
with such local authority.

contravention of the provisions of section 3 or section 4 shall be punishable

6. Compensation‑----(1) If any owner or lessee, or any
Company, railway administration or local authority claims compensation for any
loss alleged to have been incurred owing to the operation of this Act, the
claim shall be submitted to the (Subs. ibid., for
"L. G.".)[Central Government].
(2) On receiving any such claim,
the (Subs. ibid., for "L. G.".)[Central
Government] (The words "subject to the control of
the G. G. in C." rep., ibid.)* * * shall pass such order thereon as
justice requires, and shall give all necessary directions for the purpose of
ascertaining the facts of the case and of assessing the compensation, if any,
to be paid.
